    # The marker color is the unique non-background color, while the ordinary
    # background is the most frequent color. Identify those explicitly.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = [x for x in counts if x not in (bg, 0)]
    if not colors:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color = colors[0]
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    # Canonicalize each of the eight square symmetries.
    forms = set()
    for reflect in (False, True):
        for rot in range(4):
            q = []
            for r, c in pts:
                x, y = (r, -c) if reflect else (r, c)
                for _ in range(rot):
                    x, y = y, -x
                q.append((x, y))
            mr, mc = min(x for x, y in q), min(y for x, y in q)
            forms.add(tuple(sorted((x-mr, y-mc) for x, y in q)))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for shape in forms:
        sh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
        sw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
        for r0 in range(h-sh+1):
            for c0 in range(w-sw+1):

                # Do not recolor the template itself; candidate cells must all be 0.
                if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r, c in cells):
                    for r, c in cells:
